node.title: DLI reduced-phase manifest soundness
node.statement: If a reduced-phase manifest covers every central profile, nonzero frequency, DLI harmonic, and square-root component, gives an Artin-Schreier-reduced local pole of positive order prime to p for each tuple, gives a certified polar-divisor majorant for the same tuple, and proves the harmonic majorant total is o(t), then both dli_odd_phase_polar_obstruction_payload and dli_reduced_pole_majorant_table_payload hold.
node.attack_surface: schema soundness tying the DLI local polar obstruction and reduced-pole majorant table to one manifest
node.falsifier: a verified reduced-phase manifest satisfying the pole and majorant predicates while one DLI payload fails
